title: Compatible strict chain models for arbitrary coefficient comparison on an open union
statement:
theorem singleComplexOpenComparison_union_compatible_chain_data
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S']
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X K)
    (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X') (hK' : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X' K')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (U V : X.Opens)
    (hUqc : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hVqc : IsCompact (V : Set X))
    (hUVqc : IsCompact ((U ⊓ V : X.Opens) : Set X)) :
    let a : X.Opens → Arrow (schemeDerivedCategory S') := fun Z ↦
      Arrow.mk (singleComplexOpenComparison f f' g g' sq.w K K' φ Z)
    ∃ (A B A' B' : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
      (t : A ⟶ B) (t' : A' ⟶ B') (α : A ⟶ A') (β : B ⟶ B')
      (hc : t ≫ β = α ≫ t')
      (e₁ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj A ≅ (a (U ⊔ V)).left)
      (e₂ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj B ≅ (a U).left ⊞ (a V).left)
      (e₃ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone t) ≅
        (a (U ⊓ V)).left)
      (e₁' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj A' ≅ (a (U ⊔ V)).right)
      (e₂' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj B' ≅ (a U).right ⊞ (a V).right)
      (e₃' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone t') ≅
        (a (U ⊓ V)).right),
      DerivedCategory.Q.map α ≫ e₁'.hom = e₁.hom ≫ (a (U ⊔ V)).hom ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map β ≫ e₂'.hom =
        e₂.hom ≫ biprod.map (a U).hom (a V).hom ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.map t t' α β hc) ≫ e₃'.hom =
        e₃.hom ≫ (a (U ⊓ V)).hom

source.place: Tags 08HZ, 08HY and 0DJ9, relative restriction sequence and coefficient comparison before passing to the derived triangle; functorial cylinder replacement as in Tags 013N and 013O. Online 08HZ, 08HY, 0DJ9 read on 2026-10-14.

proof.text: Set W=U union V and restrict the cartesian square and both coefficient objects to W. Its inverse-image opens A and B cover W. Apply relativeMV_cover_rows to this cover and the explicitly restricted coefficient morphism, obtaining a morphism m between short exact rows P and P′, with its three prescribed localized components.

For Z=U,V,U intersection V, identify the nested comparison with the ambient comparison using the canonical isomorphism of nested open schemes and the pullback-pasting isomorphism on inverse images. The coefficient coherence theorem verifies the hypothesis of exists_derivedBaseChange_source_iso. The global row arrow is definitionally the ambient comparison on W, so needs no transport. These are isomorphisms of arrows, retaining the prescribed coefficient morphism.

Take t=P.f, t′=P′.f, alpha=m.τ₁, beta=m.τ₂ and the strict square from m.comm₁₂. Mathlib CochainComplex.mappingCone.quasiIso_descShortComplex identifies the cones with P.X₃ and P′.X₃ after localization. Its map_descShortComplex naturality identity identifies the cone map with Q(m.τ₃). Transport the six vertex isomorphisms along the arrow isomorphisms of the preceding step. Biproduct projection extensionality combines the two middle component identities, and biproduct map naturality transports their sum. These calculations yield exactly all three required equalities.

Functorial mapping cylinder short exact sequence with all three components
mathlib_searches.results: Eight generic short-complex and cylinder results; none constructs the geometric comparison with the pinned coefficient arrow.
Generic strict cone maps and map_eq_mapOfHomotopy; these do not give compatible geometric representatives.

StandardSingleUnionSESChainData handles an ordinary single coefficient with standard derived instances, not arbitrary K,K′ and φ. SingleComplexOpenUnionSESCore chooses α=β=0 and provides only object isomorphisms. No compatible model theorem for this input.
